title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closes the US session at sixty-three thousand six hundred seventy-seven dollars, up zero point eight percent, holding ground while fear and greed sits at twenty-nine. 

Hashrate remains robust at seven hundred eighty-four EH/s, underscoring miner conviction. The mempool shows ninety-nine thousand seven hundred sixty-seven transactions with fees as low as two sat per vbyte, pointing to light urgency despite congestion. 

Key takeaway: price resilience in fear territory without volume conf
